scope: Project protocol 4 executed audio-command observation, legacy UI preservation, two source roles and reviewed script starter
verified: Real project runtime query admits protocol 4 and preserves existing protocol 1, 2 and 3 presentation
Empty supported history is distinct from absent capability; command labels never infer current playback
Exact track provenance and optional sourceRange remain distinct from controlling behavior declaration
Receipt append preserves focused DOM and an admitted source ticket; changed row or owner cancels it
Initial busy blocks new reads; the host own-loading state does not revoke an admitted read
Dirty/creating, visit changes, new tasks, hidden view, removal and filters revoke stale navigation
Search is retained across visits and cleared for a new run
Chinese, English and Japanese labels; author strings remain literal text
New starter is an ordinary reviewed draft with no registration or execution authority; missing project/track guard, deferred event publication and strict boolean payloads
limitations: No native audio device, real Godot or Chrome is exercised by these UI tests; separate host/browser evidence covers those paths.
The i18n diagnostics service suite is delegated to root because this process cannot bind a local server.
The default child-process test IPC is unavailable under the subagent sandbox; test isolation is disabled to report each actual test.
